title: MLK Assassination Files: 230,000+ Pages (2025)
summary: July 21, 2025 — 230,000+ pages released per EO 14176: the FBI MURKIN (Murder-King) investigation file; responsive CIA records; the State Department file on James Earl Ray's extradition from the UK; internal FBI memos and investigative leads. Per ODNI, unlike most JFK files these had never been digitized. Major claims (FBI/CIA conspiracy, Ray framed): no primary-document support reported.
tldr: On July 21, 2025, the National Archives released 243,496 pages (6,302 PDFs plus one MP3) of MLK assassination records under Executive Order 14176 — including FBI MURKIN investigation files, CIA-related records, and extradition cables on James Earl Ray.
ai_summary:
AI review of the National Archives' MLK assassination records release page (archives.gov/research/mlk), read in full:
- President Trump signed Executive Order 14176 on January 23, 2025, ordering declassification of records on the JFK, RFK, and MLK assassinations; NARA coordinates a 'prioritized interagency process' to review and release them on a rolling basis.
- The July 21, 2025 release (3:30 PM ET) totaled 243,496 pages across 6,302 PDF files and 1 MP3 audio file, listed in a release table with NARA record numbers and release dates.
- The file inventory includes FBI MURKIN ('Murder-King') records (e.g. 06556318_murkin_april_20_1968.pdf), CIA-related documents, HSCA/congressional records, and extradition cables concerning James Earl Ray (e.g. 00436863_cable-extradition_james_e...).
- NARA warns researchers that some information 'may be withheld under FOIA, as required by law,' and that records are added 'on a rolling basis as they are released.'
- Record summary broadly consistent with the release page on the core facts; two claims could not be verified from this source — the ODNI 'never digitized' detail, and the assessment that major conspiracy claims have no primary-document support.
